notes.title: Ready, Steady, Ship! Patch 1.2.0
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43239077/5c38b287967c9e8c92400e845dd3eab2896a4850.png[/img]
[b][h3]Greetings, Factory Workers![/h3][/b]
[h3]We're fixing gears here and there to make your shifts easier and to ensure more packages are leaving the factory! Take a look at what kind of enhancements and fine-tunings are coming with Patch 1.2.0![/h3]

[h3][b]Patch Notes - Version 1.2.0[/b][/h3]
[h3][b]Factory changes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[b][*] Co-op and Singleplayer Level Physics Tweaks[/b]Fixes in levels 7, 8, 9, 12, 14, 24, 26, 27, 28, 29, and 30, so boxes should no longer get stuck on corners or fail to pass through where they’re supposed to.

[b][*] Metal Boxes Physics Tweak[/b]Metal boxes have been adjusted to avoid getting jammed under conveyors.

[b][*] Unfolded & Unfilled Boxes Adjustment[/b]These boxes will now behave more predictably on conveyors, reducing unnecessary rolling when stacked.

[b][*] Level 30 (Stage 2 Springs) Tweak[/b]We’ve adjusted the springs to provide more stability, making sure that your cargo stays put.
[/list]

[b][h3][b]Additional Changes[/b][/h3][/b][list]
[b][*] Potential Input Problem Fix[/b]Addressed a rare issue where the game didn’t respond for some users. 

[b][*] ‘THANK YOU’ Screen Bugfix[/b]The credits will now roll out as intended. 
[/list]
[h3Keep on shipping, and thank you for being an integral part of our continuous improvement journey.
[i]The Factory Management Team[/i][/h3]

[b]Spread the word, toss a follow and see you in the factory![/b]
Follow us for more info: [url=https://twitter.com/JollybitsGames]Twitter[/url]

[i]Don't forget about our friends at [url=https://twitter.com/UntoldTalesHQ]Untold Tales[/url][/i]

notes.title: Ready, Steady, Ship! Patch 1.1.0
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43239077/8b9faece3a1ceaaac039ca4b8287fc89bae7fa8d.png[/img]
[b][h3]Welcome Factory Workers![/h3][/b]
[h3]Whether you’re a seasoned veteran who knows the rhythmic dance of machinery like a cherished melody or a fresh recruit eager to learn the steps, know that we are constantly working to improve the way our factory operates.

Today we are happy to present you with a few improvements and changes along with the [b]NEW DIFFICULTY SETTING[/b] available for all![/h3]

[h3][b]Patch Notes - Version 1.1.0[/b][/h3]
[h3][b]Factory changes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[b][*] Improved Forklift Steering[/b]Enhancements to forklift controls for better maneuverability.

[b][*] Crane Mode Changes[/b]All cranes now feature ropes, making them easier to use.

[b][*] Box Physics Tweaked[/b]Boxes are now more stable while on the conveyor system. Improved stability even when boxes are thrown around.

[b][*] Emergency Exit Mechanic Update[/b]Emergency exit is available only in the 3rd stage. To unlock the doors and exit the stage early, you need to collect at least one star.

[/list]
[b][h3][b]New Difficulty Setting- Easy Difficulty[/b][/h3][/b][list]
[*] [b]Timer removed[/b]
Allowing players to focus on solving challenges without time pressure.
[*][b] Additional fixing time[/b]
Provides additional time to fix breakable conveyors.
[*] [b]Forklift Mechanic Reworked [/b]
Introduces forklift object snapping assist for smoother handling. When grabbing a pallet with the forklift, you can now click to snap it onto the fork, preventing it from falling during movement.[/list]
[h3]May our forklifts glide smoothly, our conveyors weave seamlessly, and our emergency exits remain accessible only for the most extraordinary of circumstances.
[i]The Factory Management Team[/i][/h3]

[b]Spread the word, toss a follow and see you in the factory![/b]

notes.title: Your shift starts on April 19th - Release Date Trailer
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43239077/c2ecf2a2b95d275ab7b6855d1e7db616552f4d8f.png[/img][h3]Get ready to dive into the frenetic world of conveyor belt chaos on April 19th! [/h3]

Your mission is crystal clear: ensure the goods keep flowing out of the factory. Armed with an array of tools and equipment, assemble conveyor belts amidst the chaos, tackling the ever-mounting challenges thrown your way.

From forklifts to cranes, springboard conveyor belts to packing foam dispensers, you’ll have an arsenal at your disposal to ensure the packages leave the factory smoothly. Put on your thinking hard hats and get those gears turning!

[previewyoutube=bI5lHvt1JwE;full][/previewyoutube]

Oh, and don't forget, you can team up with a fellow conveyor enthusiast for maximum chaos! Grab a friend, communicate, and juggle tasks frantically. Remember, teamwork makes the conveyor belt dream work.

[i]P.S. No forklift driving license needed![/i]


[b]Spread the word, toss a wishlist, follow our way and see you soon![/b]
